responsibility: Implements lowering of parsed Rust format_args-style data into concrete AST expressions during expansion. Given an AST::FormatArgs template and arguments, this file maps format specifiers to core::fmt traits, builds core::fmt::ArgumentV1::new calls for each formatted argument, assembles the static string-piece array and argument slice, and produces the final core::fmt::Arguments::new_v1 invocation as an AST::Fragment for later compilation stages.
same_name_distinction: Implements the actual lowering from parsed FormatArgs pieces to core::fmt AST calls, including trait selection and Arguments::new_v1 construction. Unlike the paired header, this .cc contains the formatting-expansion algorithm and AST synthesis, not merely the helper declaration.
